ACUTE ONCOLOGY FOLLOW-UP NOTE

Pt:[redacted] DOB:[redacted] MRN:[redacted]

BACKGROUND
63F w/papillary urothelial neoplasm dx 2019. T2N0, Stage II. Dukes equiv not applicable. Initial surgical resection [redacted] Hospital. TMB intermediate (8.1 mut/Mb). Molecular markers not indicated per protocol.

COMPLEX TREATMENT HISTORY
2019: TURBT followed by adjuvant intravesical BCG x6 cycles
2020: Local recurrence, salvage cystectomy + ileal conduit. Margins clear.
2021: Started on gemcitabine/cisplatin chemo (4 cycles) for peritoneal mets identified on CT. Partial response.
2021: Enrolled BLAZER trial (investigational agent + pembrolizumab). Discontinued after 8 cycles due to grade 3 colitis.
2022: Second-line carboplatin/paclitaxel (6 cycles). Stable disease maintained.
2023: Radiotherapy to pelvic nodes 45Gy in 25# completed [redacted]. Well tolerated.
2023: CT showed peritoneal progression. Discussed at MDT for further trial options - not suitable due to PS decline.
2024: Third-line single-agent vinflunine commenced. Dose reduced 20% after cycle 2 for neutropenia.

CURRENT PRESENTATION
Seen today post A&E attendance 48h ago w/abdominal pain + vomiting. Admitted overnight, discharged yesterday.

EXAMINATION
ECOG 3. Wheelchair dependent, requires assistance for ADLs. Abdominal distension present, mild tenderness RIF. No acute surgical signs. Stoma functioning.

MENTAL STATE
Pt remains remarkably positive despite disease burden. Family well engaged, coping well at home with care package.

RECENT IMAGING
CT TAP [redacted]: stable peritoneal disease, no new mets. Small volume ascites unchanged. Primary site post-surgical changes only.

ASSESSMENT
Papillary urothelial neoplasm with peritoneal metastases, stable on current systemic therapy despite functional decline. Disease trajectory stable over past 6mo, no significant progression radiologically.

PLAN DISCUSSED
Continue vinflunine, monitor closely for further toxicity
Arrange CT restaging 8wks
MDT re-discussion if progression documented
Palliative care input for symptom management
Community support optimised

Pt deteriorated rapidly at home over following 2wks. Re-admitted [redacted] with bowel obstruction, sepsis. Discussed DNACPR. Patient died [redacted] with family present.

Dr [redacted]
Acute Oncology Team
